scope: Actual original-source and Talos-source native iOS simulator applications, installed sequentially without uninstall; synthetic account and local relay only.

candidateConfigCorrection.description: Removed generated associated-domains entitlement to match the final production configuration and the baseline store profile. This is the only app source change after the candidate snapshot.

fixtureOverrides.nativeBuildNumbers: Local prebuild value 1 on both simulator fixtures; production build numbering is EAS-managed.
fixtureOverrides.dependencies: Existing installed monorepo dependencies via temporary snapshot symlinks. Native package versions match the original-source baseline.
fixtureOverrides.metro: Temporary snapshot watch folders and canonical entry paths for symlinked dependencies.

storage.note: Simulator installation reallocated the data container and retained its contents. Default MMKV bytes changed as the upgraded app loaded and sent a message; the server-config store remained byte-identical.

automation.legacySchemeCliPairing: passed; actual Talos CLI auth login completed after approval in the old native app through happy://terminal
automation.nativeContinuation: passed; native composer sent plaintext, real relay stored encrypted message, same session count increased 2 to 3
automation.preferenceInspection: passed; visible native Appearance control reports Always use light theme / Light
automation.sessionPresenceFixture: A socket authenticated with the isolated synthetic CLI token emitted session-alive for the existing session during continuation. No model execution or daemon launch was performed.

limitations: The simulator binaries are rebuilt from source, not the downloaded App Store IPA. The actual store IPA was inspected separately in baseline-signing.json.
Ad hoc simulator signing does not validate App Store provisioning or keychain access-group enforcement. Compare the final EAS distribution artifact with the verified baseline before submission.
This evidence does not assert a physical-device TestFlight upgrade or Android signing/upgrade test.
No paid model run was performed; continuation proves native encryption, transport, persistence, and decryption of a message in the retained session.
